idea-plugin.name: PHP Composer Script Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Gutter icon per "scripts" entry of an open composer.json, showing whether it's used or an orphan candidate -- checks the script's own composer.json (calling another script), GitHub Actions/GitLab CI configs, and README.md for a real composer run-script <name> or composer <name> invocation.

Recognizes Composer's own documented script event names (pre-install-cmd, post-autoload-dump, etc.) as always-used, same as npm lifecycle scripts.

100% static PSI/text analysis, no Composer CLI invocation. Stated honestly: v0.1 checks GitHub Actions and GitLab CI only (not Jenkinsfile/CircleCI/Azure Pipelines) -- a real, documented gap, not a hidden one.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
